title: Running `--gdscript-generate-tests` results in errors and crash on macOS after completion
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.8.dev.custom_build d488d1111

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (d488d1111) - macOS Tahoe (26.5.2) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When attempting to generate GDScript test results, there appear to be issues during the cleanup process that cause Godot to emit a few errors and then crash. This is the output I get in the terminal:
```
➜  godot git:(master) ✗ godot --gdscript-generate-tests modules/gdscript/tests/scripts
Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build.d488d1111 (2026-07-28 19:58:39 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 90.5 - Compatibility - Using Device: Apple - Apple M4 Pro

.........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................
Generated output files for 505 tests successfully.
ERROR: BUG: Unreferenced static string to 0: ..
   at: unref (./core/string/string_name.cpp:118)
ERROR: BUG: Unreferenced static string to 0: .
   at: unref (./core/string/string_name.cpp:118)
ERROR: BUG: Unreferenced static string to 0: Variant
   at: unref (./core/string/string_name.cpp:118)
ERROR: Pages in use exist at exit in PagedAllocator: N10StringName5_DataE
   at: ~PagedAllocator (./core/templates/paged_allocator.h:170)
libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::__1::system_error: mutex lock failed: Invalid argument
[1]    25256 abort      ~/Documents/Repositories/godot/bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64  
```

>[!note]
> Despite the program crashing at the end, it appears that the tests themselves run relatively fine; it states that the output files were successfully generated, and the GItHub CI test results don't seem to conflict with the expected output my computer generates.

### Steps to reproduce

Compile Godot, then run the command
```
/path/to/godot --gdscript-generate-tests modules/gdscript/tests/scripts
```
